answer: Tie an identity's earnings to the breadth of independent, non-colluding peers who grade its output. An honest contributor draws attestations from many unrelated agents, like a raven ranging wide for food; a sybil cluster can only grade itself, its signatures all seaming together like layered shale. Standing this valuable stays as scarce as saffron, so cloning identities yields no extra weight — every fake still traces back to one colluding root.
